structure.name: The Hand
structure.form: five documents, five laws, five operations
structure.principle: A hand has five fingers. No finger is the hand. Remove one and the hand is wounded — but still a hand. The hand is not the fingers; the hand is what the fingers do together.

fingers.doc: Whose Face Is on the Twenty?
fingers.operation: Hold the object still for examination. Establish provenance. Fix the frame so the kernel can be extracted.
Direct attention. Demonstrate that the mechanism generalises — that what was noticed is structural, not incidental.
Perform the transformation. Document what changed, what stayed fixed, and what each change contributed.
Covenant the discipline. Make the method explicit, the vocabulary shared, the predictions testable.
Lock the integrity. Ensure the five documents are a room, not a collection.

structure.coordination: GRASP without POINT is grip without direction. POINT without WORK is diagnosis without treatment. WORK without BIND is labour without legacy. BIND without SEAL is covenant without closure. SEAL without GRASP is lock without object.

five_laws.law: Identity is a dependent variable of presentation.
five_laws.note: The same steel lines read through different curatorial parameters produce a different social object. The statues move because the light changes, not because the stone does.

The conventions of institutional representation confer status on whatever occupies them. President, financier, dinosaur. The convention set does not check credentials. The rubies do not ask who you are. They make you look like you run the world.

five_laws.law: The gap is where meaning is manufactured.
five_laws.note: The undocumented interval between official rationale and aesthetic specifics. The gap is not a failure. It is the mechanism. The statues stand in it.
The room admits memes as primary sources. The door is open to shitposts. An observation wrapped in an inadequate frame is still an observation. The memographer’s task is extraction, not judgment.
Manus + plere: to fill by hand. The room is not a viewing gallery. It is a workshop. The statues are not behind glass. They are in your hands.

constitution.series_thesis: Portrait authority is not carried by identity alone but is produced through curatorial presentation decisions that govern legibility, status, and social ontology.

integrity_lock.mechanism: The five documents share a vocabulary of twelve terms, a five-stage method, five laws, five operations, a proof structure (forensic-historical → control → constructive → disciplinary → architectural), and a holographic cross-reference system in which each document carries compressed seeds of every other.
integrity_lock.behaviour: If any document is altered, the holographic seeds in the other four register the inconsistency. If any is removed, the other four still contain its essential contribution.
integrity_lock.statement: The lock is not cryptographic. It is semantic. It holds because the arguments hold. It breaks if the arguments break. That is the only kind of integrity that matters.

failure_modes.name: Amputation
failure_modes.what: A document is lost or inaccessible. Memographic manipulation becomes impaired but not impossible — the holographic seeds preserve the lost finger’s contribution at reduced resolution.

failure_modes.name: Fusion
failure_modes.what: Two documents merge their functions until indistinguishable. The grip weakens because the same operation is performed twice and another not at all.

failure_modes.name: Holographic collapse
failure_modes.what: A document ceases to contain the whole. Traversal from it can no longer reconstruct the complete hand.

failure_modes.name: Seal breach
failure_modes.what: The integrity lock is contradicted, ignored or superseded without replacement. The hand becomes a collection — five related papers rather than a room.
failure_modes.resisted_by: this charter, by being as permanent as the documents it seals

constitution.emergence: The room was not designed in advance and then populated. It was discovered in the practice — the documents were written, and the room emerged around them, the way a hand emerges when you close your fingers around something worth holding.
constitution.name_precedence: The phrase "moving statues made of rubies" appears in Lee Sharks’ published literary works, predating this room’s construction. Not a novel coinage but a returning motif. The rubies predate the room, just as the observation predates the method.
